In 2004, Marika's 8th birthday, her father was 32 years old (since his age was four times hers). This means Marika was born in 1996 and her father was born in 1972. 

To find the year when her father's age will be three times her age, we set up the equation where \( x \) is the number of years after 2004:
\[
32 + x = 3(8 + x)
\]
Solving for \( x \):
\[
32 + x = 24 + 3x \\
8 = 2x \\
x = 4
\]

Thus, in 2004 + 4 = 2008, Marika will be 12 years old and her father will be 36 years old, which is three times her age.
